CRITIC_TRAINING_SEMANTICS.ROLLOUT_VALUE: Raw denormalized V(s_t) sampled for the pre-action observation; reward_t and done_t are stored for that same transition.
CRITIC_TRAINING_SEMANTICS.ADVANTAGE: delta_t = r_t + gamma*(1-done_t)*V_old(s_{t+1}) - V_old(s_t); A_t = delta_t + gamma*lambda*(1-done_t)*A_{t+1}.
CRITIC_TRAINING_SEMANTICS.CRITIC_TARGET: R_t = A_t + V_old(s_t), a GAE/lambda return that uses rollout-time Critic bootstrap values at intermediate states.
CRITIC_TRAINING_SEMANTICS.NONTERMINAL_RETURN_RECURSION: R_t = r_t + gamma*((1-lambda)*V_old(s_{t+1}) + lambda*R_{t+1}); terminal mask removes bootstrap and continuation.
CRITIC_TRAINING_SEMANTICS.EFFECTIVE_LAMBDA_MIXTURE_HORIZON: Approximately 20 transitions by the geometric mixture mean, with a terminal tail; not a pure Monte-Carlo target.
CRITIC_TRAINING_SEMANTICS.ACTOR_CRITIC_TARGET_COUPLING: Actor advantages and Critic returns come from the same compute_gae call and use the same gamma and lambda.
CRITIC_TRAINING_SEMANTICS.POPART_UPDATE_ORDER: Welford and PopArt statistics update from GAE returns before normalized Critic targets are formed.
CRITIC_TRAINING_SEMANTICS.RAW_LOSS: Raw-value residual is detached and used for diagnostics only.
CRITIC_TRAINING_SEMANTICS.POPART_TRANSFORM: V_raw=mu+sigma*z; output-head transformation rescales weights/bias to preserve raw values.
CRITIC_TRAINING_SEMANTICS.CHECKPOINT_RESTORE: Static load path restores model PopArt buffers and Welford state, then validates their active mean/std match.

OPTIMIZATION.OPTIMIZER: Disjoint Actor/Critic parameter groups; separate Adam Critic optimizer.
OPTIMIZATION.CRITIC_LOSS_ACTIVE_PATH: critic_loss=value_loss, backward, gradient clip, Critic Adam step; no coefficient multiplication or duplicate scaling.
OPTIMIZATION.CRITIC_LEARNING_RATE_SOURCE: configs/proposed/system_config.toml algorithm.ppo.critic_learning_rate; default override path resolves to 1e-3.
OPTIMIZATION.LR_SCHEDULER: No Critic learning-rate scheduler found in inspected production path.

WARMUP_EVIDENCE.INTERPRETATION: Post Critic MAE is about 5.7x closer to the GAE training target than MC return. Forty steps modestly improved metrics, but MC EV remains near zero and no step-count ablation exists.

IMPLEMENTATION_BUG_AUDIT.RETURN_INDEX_ALIGNMENT: No deterministic bug witness; reward_t and V_old(s_t) share a transition, next-state value enters the next TD residual.
IMPLEMENTATION_BUG_AUDIT.TERMINAL_MASK: No deterministic bug witness; done masks continuation/bootstrap, and terminal full-episode rollout has no bootstrap observation.
IMPLEMENTATION_BUG_AUDIT.GAMMA_EXPONENT: No deterministic bug witness; gamma is multiplied at every recurrence step.
IMPLEMENTATION_BUG_AUDIT.OBSERVATION_ALIGNMENT: No deterministic bug witness; value is sampled on s_t before action execution.
IMPLEMENTATION_BUG_AUDIT.POPART_NORMALIZE_DENORMALIZE: No deterministic bug witness; raw denormalization and output-head transform are algebraically consistent.
IMPLEMENTATION_BUG_AUDIT.CHECKPOINT_RELOAD: No deterministic bug witness; model PopArt buffers and Welford state restore and are checked for consistency.
IMPLEMENTATION_BUG_AUDIT.OPTIMIZER_STEP_AND_GRADIENT: No deterministic bug witness; Critic step is present, normalized loss retains gradients, and Actor gradient is checked absent.
